title: A different model family is preferred, never required
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. The assayers are replaced by reviewers.
decision: Reviewers, the illustrator and the check-writer run on another model family than the builders where one is available, and on any available model otherwise. Unavailability of a family never stops the work.
